entry.title: Your best AX fixes are hiding in agent trajectories | Microsoft for Developers

entry.content: All five agent runs produced a working script, and nothing in the eval score looked wrong. The trajectories told a different story. Every run read a DLL as raw bytes to find plugin names, and three scripts would quietly reroute a CI runner's network traffic.
